description: This file provides functions and classes for handling auto-completion and hole-filling in code, including parsing responses with <COMPLETION> tags, generating prompts, and executing chat-based completions.

classes.name: HoleFiller
classes.description: A class responsible for generating prompts, parsing responses, and managing chat-based code hole filling.

methods.name: parseGhostResponse
methods.description: Parses a response string to extract content within <COMPLETION> tags and returns a suggestion object.

methods.name: getPrompts
methods.description: Generates prompt objects for the hole filler, including system instructions and user prompts.

methods.name: getSystemInstructions
methods.description: Returns the instructions string for the hole filler, detailing rules and context format.

methods.name: getUserPrompt
methods.description: Builds the user prompt string with context snippets and placeholders for auto-completion.

methods.name: getFromChat
methods.description: Executes a chat-based completion request, processes the response, and returns the suggestion with usage info.
